parent_design.important_preoutcome_choice: exact-match-kernel unbiased MMD2/collision U-statistic was frozen by V2 before V2.1 opens its outcome

design_principle: reuse valid frozen evidence before rerun; every additional experiment must buy a reviewer-verdict-changing identification or precision distinction

m2_zero_provider_collision_diagnostic.source: historical replay-qualified B10 success_memory/failure_memory first-action draws
m2_zero_provider_collision_diagnostic.action_identity: first structured action name; click_element additionally includes interactive-element index
m2_zero_provider_collision_diagnostic.global_statistic: mean U_i over the 36 fixed states

randomization_test.scheme: within each state pool the 8 S/F signatures, shuffle, assign 4/4 pseudo-branches, recompute mean U
randomization_test.tail: randomized mean U >= observed mean U

report: fixed-state bootstrap interval as descriptive uncertainty

decision_rules.D1_supported_separation: revise strict pre-action wording; keep post-hoc status; fresh prospective replicate only if primary stochasticity-controlled divergence claim is verdict-changing
decision_rules.D2_not_supported: retain first-action as first unsupported measured stage; allow only non-equivalence wording; do not chase significance
decision_rules.D3_precision_inconclusive: run zero-provider calibration before any prospective fresh block

authorization_requires: current 4+4 support is insufficient for a reviewer-verdict-changing distinction
fresh independent stochasticity-controlled evidence is required for the intended manuscript claim
m2_prospective_fresh_block.sample_size_selection: smallest n meeting predeclared false-positive and sensitivity targets under replay-qualified concentration structure plus synthetic null/alternative stress family

reddit_E_U.priority: use existing Reddit before any third domain
reddit_E_U.trigger: post-M2 independent submission review says cross-domain stage-boundary replication is verdict-changing

second_executor.trigger: post-M2 independent review says model/configuration specificity is verdict-changing

explicit_rejections: rerun B10 merely because historical primary metric was TV
treat 288 S/F repeated decodes as independent scientific units
adaptive sample-size top-up after inspecting significance
PACTA-MSR as rescue for the current measurement paper
